notes: On iPhone and Android, a new "Save to Photos" button puts your enlargement straight into Photos.
"Save to Files" now tells you where the file went (Files app → Downloads).
If a file can't be made, you now see a clear message instead of nothing.
Large prints (like 20 × 30 at 300 ppi) use less memory on phones.
Clearer warnings before very large jobs, with the reason if one stops.
